title: Audit Evidence
description: Per-audit aggregate of every finding from every worker, after Pass A has stamped each with a verdict (REAL / FP / UNCERTAIN). This file is the single source of truth for counts and citations in the report. The synthesis step computes report counts as len(findings where verdict == 'REAL') per category — no narrated numbers.

pass_a_completed_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when Pass A finished classifying all findings.

findings_by_rule.description: Map of rule_id -> array of Finding objects (matching finding.schema.json). Every finding from every worker appears here exactly once, with verdict and verification_method populated by Pass A.

summary.description: Per-rule aggregate counts. Derived from findings_by_rule by Pass A; the synthesis step reads these instead of recounting. NEVER surfaces FP / UNCERTAIN counts to the report — Rule 1.8.

distinct_files.description: Number of distinct files containing REAL findings of this rule.

category_counts.description: REAL-finding counts grouped by category — drives the per-category severity table in the report.
